acquisition method: Mass spectrometers were operated in the data-dependent mode
cleavage agent: The MS/MS tolerance was set to 20 ppm and three missed cleavages were allowed using trypsin/P as enzyme specificity.
collision energy: a maximum of 10 MS/MS scans were performed using a normalized collision energy of 25%
enrichment method: metal oxide affinity enrichment using titanium dioxide
Phosphopeptides were enriched by metal oxide affinity enrichment using titanium dioxide (GL Sciences Inc, Tokyo, Japan).
instrument: LC-MS/MS measurements were performed on a QExactive Plus mass spectrometer coupled to an EasyLC 1000 nanoflow-HPLC.
ionization type: NanoESI spray voltage was set to 2.3 kV
labeling: LC-MS/MS measurements were performed on a QExactive Plus mass spectrometer coupled to an EasyLC 1000 nanoflow-HPLC.
fragment tolerance: The MS/MS tolerance was set to 20 ppm and three missed cleavages were allowed using trypsin/P as enzyme specificity.
ptm: Carbamidomethylcysteine (fixed); protein amino-terminal acetylation (variable); serine-phosphorylation (variable); threonine-phosphorylation (variable); tyrosine-phosphorylation (variable); oxidation of methionine (variable)

Carbamidomethylcysteine was set as fixed modification and protein amino-terminal acetylation, serine-, threonine- and tyrosine-phosphorylation, and oxidation of methionine were set as variable modifications.
reduction reagent: Assays were quenched by 8 M urea and 1 mM DTT.
reduction concentration: Assays were quenched by 8 M urea and 1 mM DTT.
